name: jvm_project_model_missing correctly reported alongside indexingStatus: ready
description: task-m3-java-project-import-readiness.md: java.jdtls (tier: unsupported) declares a readiness profile (language/status -> ServiceReady), unlike clangd - so a real jdtls run against a build-system-free, multi-file workspace reports indexingStatus: ready (its own indexing genuinely finished) while jvmProjectModelDetails() still fires, because readiness answers 'is the index done', not 'is there a project model that could see across files'. This is the response shape a real end-to-end run against the real jdtls v1.61.0 binary actually produced (Target.java calling Caller.java's target with no build.gradle/pom.xml present). The summary names both jvm_project_model_missing and no_incoming_callers explicitly and never asserts the symbol is uncalled. Must-pass fixture 31 - also the fixture that proves the new jvm_project_model_missing entry in LIMITATION_SURFACE_PATTERNS matches real prose ('No Gradle or Maven project file was found'), not only the underscored code name.
